notes.title: Update 3.0.0.0
notes.content:
Hey all, 

This is it, Bitter sweet! The final update to RAGE.. it's been a journey, I have learned so much making RAGE.  I wanna give a HUGE thanks to everyone who supported the project, and a special thanks to my Devs. Wouldn't have done it with out my great team.

What's next?

Only time will tell, I think i am gonna take a break from game design and focus on my youtube channel, I am still very heavy into unreal engine, and i am utilizing it to make ASMR videos for my channel.. 

I would be super grateful if you could head over and Subscribe, as i am very close to the 1000 subs i need. https://www.youtube.com/@ArtStrongArts

Again, thankful and grateful for all the support you have all shown for this project.. 

Enjoy the new level and boss and many addiations and secrets i have added to RAGE! Have fun finding them all :)

-Peace

ArtStrong

notes.title: Update 2.5.0.0
notes.content:
Hey All, 

Well it's that time again, were back with a new update and this one is juicy.

- RAGE has been upgraded to Unreal 5.5 with all the new goodies that come with it.
- Fully dynamic and interactive weather.
- Countless bug fixes, game and graphical improvements. 
- Brand new hidden secret areas abound with riches and loot to find.

I also did a details pass and added in more items to smash, minions to destroy and points of interest.

This is a pretty big update, and there is more to come in the near future.

Thanks to everyone who has played RAGE and given feedback, it has helped us to improve RAGE and make it more fun, and continue to help you all to relieve some stress :)

Till next time.

Kind regards from us all at ArtStrong Games
